# Anthony Baptiste — Strategy, Growth and Analytics

Personal portfolio: https://antbap23.github.io/career-site/

Anthony Baptiste is based in Chicago / Northern Illinois and works as a Digital Experimentation Analyst at Ulta Beauty. He graduated from Northern Illinois University in Operations & Information Management with a Computer Science minor.

His experience spans growth consulting, customer and competitive research, digital experimentation, operations analytics, and applied AI research. He is interested in growth strategy, consulting, and business analytics opportunities.

## Selected experience
- Ulta Beauty: analyzed customer journeys across 20+ digital experiments to inform launch, iteration, and discontinuation decisions.
- Shipt: analyzed coverage across 30,000+ ZIP codes and automated reporting, saving 10+ hours per week.
- Mystery Street Recording Company, through NIU Experiential Learning Center: benchmarked 15+ competitors and presented prioritized growth recommendations to company leadership.
- Innovation DuPage: standardized 20+ KPIs and reduced reporting cycle time by 40%.
- NIU: compared 28 human interviews with 28 AI-simulated interviews, examining alignment, bias, consistency, nuance, and contextual depth.
- ACM Community Ambassador: student outreach, event promotion, recruiting, and community engagement.
